method.assets: Production CSS and generated production SVG Wordmark
method.data: Synthetic in-memory fixtures and mock clients only
method.renderer: Standalone Electron offscreen renderer with an in-memory secure custom scheme
method.summary_derivation: Derived from final renderer results; visual observations from sampled PNG inspection. Not a byte-identical raw log.

sampled_pixel_inspection.coverage: Representative samples span every state, both themes and both widths
observations: No blocking visual defect found in inspected component pixels
Long unbroken report text wraps within the narrow pane
Stale-source warnings and disabled confirmations remain readable
Uncertain acknowledgements expose exact retry rather than a replacement action
Unavailable review status is not displayed as an assumed review state
White area beneath short dark components is standalone harness canvas, not component styling

limitations: Not live-host, installed-plugin, production-profile or provider integration verification
Scheduled research history used empty synthetic history; scheduled-report acknowledgement was mounted separately
Research unknown-save rendering used a retained synthetic attempt
Full keyboard traversal, touch emulation and screen-reader behavior were not verified
DOM focus checks do not certify complete accessibility
Research buttons measured 36px with desktop pointer styling; coarse-pointer behavior was not tested
Initial data-URL harness attempts failed URL-size or secure-context requirements; the final complete run used a secure offline custom scheme
External-request count describes the instrumented browser session, not an operating-system packet capture
Raw results and harness contain local paths and are not included in this public record
